scope: Actual service methods with in-memory Prisma substitutes. No HTTP, real database, production data, or database concurrency test. Private helpers are exercised directly.

results.claim: Real movement helper records signed deltas and rejects overdraft
Real COUNT effect calculation reaches the target and does not duplicate the same effect
Real posting validation rejects stale count snapshots
A count below held stock is blocked until holds are resolved
Releasing a partly consumed hold blocks its loss reversal; a fresh count repairs quantity but leaves loss provenance unchanged
An unsigned historical adjustment cannot reconstruct a signed ledger
